verses.text: God spoke all these words: 📜
‘I am Yahweh your God. I brought you out of Egypt, out of slavery. 🛡️
‘You must not have any other gods besides me. 🙏
‘Don’t make an idol for yourself or an image of anything in the sky above, on the earth below, or in the water under the earth. 🚫
‘Don’t bow down to them or serve them. I, Yahweh your God, am jealous for your loyalty. I bring the consequences of parents’ sin on the third and fourth generations of those who hate me, ⚖️
I show faithful love to thousands who love me and keep my commands. ❤️
‘Don’t misuse the name of Yahweh your God. Yahweh won’t treat anyone who misuses his name as innocent. 📣
‘Remember the Sabbath day and keep it holy. 🕊️
‘Work for six days and do all your work, 🛠️
‘but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God. Don’t work—you, your son or daughter, your male or female servant, your livestock, or the foreigner staying in your town. 🛌
‘Yahweh made the sky, earth, sea, and everything in them in six days, then rested on the seventh. That’s why Yahweh blessed the Sabbath day and made it holy. 🌍
‘Honor your father and mother, so you can live long in the land Yahweh your God is giving you. 👨‍👩‍👧
‘Do not murder. 🛑
‘Do not commit adultery. 💍
‘Do not steal. 🚫
‘Do not lie about your neighbor in court. ⚖️
‘Do not desire your neighbor’s house. Don’t desire your neighbor’s wife, male or female servant, ox, donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.’ 🏠
The people heard the thunder, saw the lightning, heard the trumpet blast, and saw the mountain covered in smoke. They trembled and stayed far away. ⛈️
They said to Moses, ‘You speak to us, and we’ll listen. Don’t let God speak to us, or we’ll die.’ 😨
Moses told the people, ‘Don’t be afraid. God came to test you, so reverence for him will stay with you and keep you from sinning.’ 🙏
The people stayed back, while Moses went closer to the thick darkness where God was. ☁️
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Tell Israel’s people: “You saw for yourselves that I spoke with you from heaven. ☁️
“‘Don’t make silver or gold gods to stand alongside me. 🚫
“‘Make an altar of earth for me. Offer your burnt offerings and peace offerings on it—your sheep and cattle. Wherever I cause my name to be remembered, I’ll come to you and bless you. 🙏
“‘If you build an altar of stone for me, don’t use cut stones. The moment you use a tool on it, you’ll defile it. 🪨
“‘Don’t climb steps to my altar, so your nakedness won’t be exposed there.’” 🕊️
